shots.title: KLING 1 · THE WALK-IN
shots.note: He walks toward the camera down a neon street, heat haze, the sign bursts into sparks

shots.title: KLING 2 · PAPARAZZI
shots.note: Cartoon paparazzi leap out, flashes pop, he shields his face and keeps walking

shots.title: KLING 3 · THE CANDLES
shots.note: Every candle flame leans toward him as he passes; the girl in red glows

shots.title: KLING 4 · HEART CONTROL PANEL
shots.note: The heart gauge swings into the red, buttons pop, a fuse blows

shots.title: KLING 5 · THE ICE BAR MELTS
shots.note: He steps in, the ice sculptures sag and melt, the AC gives up

shots.title: KLING 6 · EVERY HEAD TURNS
shots.note: A packed rooftop party: on the beat, every head turns to him

shots.title: KLING 7 · HEART POP
shots.note: A giant heart balloon swells over the crowd and pops into confetti

lines.en: Girl, I'm too hot to handle
I move like a candle, you're one angle of the fire
Girl, you smile and I lose my heart's control panel
Girl, I'm too hot to handle
Eyes on me, you're one angle
Heart went pop, oops! it's a scandal!
